relationships.subject: melatonin
relationships.evidence_quote: SNL provoked severe allodynia which was suppressed by the administration of melatonin, a caspase-1 inhibitor (VX-765), or an NF-κB inhibitor (BAY 11-7085)

relationships.subject: melatonin
relationships.evidence_quote: melatonin has potent analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects in SNL models through preventing pyroptosis via the NF-κB/NLRP3 inflammasome signaling pathway

key_findings: Melatonin alleviates SNL allodynia and pyroptosis via NF-κB/NLRP3 signaling; effects enhanced by VX-765 or BAY 11-7085.
